Motagua]] finished at the top of the standings for their first time since [[2009–10 Honduran Liga Nacional|2010]]. [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] eliminated [[Real C.D. The Vida footballers strongly rejected the request.{{cite web |title=Encendida polémica entre Vida y Marathon por culpa de un "pasillo" |url=http://www.oncenoticias.hn/encendida-polemica-entre-vida-y-marathon-por-culpa-de-un-pasillo/ |website=OnceNoticias.hn |publisher=Once Noticias |access-date=31 July 2018}} One week later, Vida simulated the ''Pasillo'' action after scoring a goal against [[Juticalpa F.C.]], a clear sign of mockery. * After a 1–1 draw between [[C.D. Marathón]] and [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] in the [[Clásico Nacional Hondureño|Clásico Nacional]] on week 3, a very irritated Marathón's coach [[Héctor Vargas]], criticized the referee's performance and insinuated Olimpia's intervention at halftime by calling the referees to fix the match.{{cite web |title=Héctor Vargas dispara: 'Dejen de llamar a los árbitros para modificar partidos' |url=http://www.laprensa.hn/deportes/1206173-410/marathon-olimpia-hector_vargas-liga_nacional_honduras-arbitros-erick_andino |website=LaPrensa.hn |publisher=[[La Prensa (Honduras)|La Prensa]] |access-date=11 August 2018}} Vargas also stated that his team with few resources is fighting on all fronts, and others with greater investments made a fool of themselves at international competitions; a clear dart to [[Real C.D. España]] who were eliminated from the [[2018 CONCACAF League]] a few days earlier. Olimpia's manager, [[Nahúm Espinoza]] decided not to comment. However, Real España's [[Martín García (footballer, born 1976)|Martín García]] expressed that Vargas is a very harmful person and his comments only reflect cowardice.{{cite web |title=¿'Mala leche' es el técnico de Marathón? |url=http://www.diariomas.hn/2018/08/13/mala-leche-el-tecnico-de-marathon/ |website=DiarioMas.hn |publisher=[[La Tribuna (Honduras)|Diario Mas]] |access-date=13 August 2018}} Vargas replied back and called García a fat man.{{cite web |title=Héctor Vargas se refiere al "Tato" García como el "Gordito" de enfrente |url=http://www.oncenoticias.hn/hector-vargas-le-dice-gordito-a-tato-garcia/ |website=OnceNoticias.hn |publisher=Once Noticias |access-date=13 August 2018}} Vargas later announced that he will keep silent for 90 days; however, the Northern Discipline Commission cited Vargas to testify for violating discriminatory codes.{{cite web |title=Comisión Regional de Disciplina del Norte, procede contra Héctor Vargas por bocón |url=http://www.elheraldo.hn/deportes/1207183-466/comisi%C3%B3n-regional-de-disciplina-del-norte-procede-contra-h%C3%A9ctor-vargas-por-boc%C3%B3n |website=ElHeraldo.hn |publisher=[[La Prensa (Honduras)|El Heraldo]] |access-date=15 August 2018}} He was suspended for three games.{{cite web |title=Héctor Vargas recibe su merecido por la CRDN |url=http://www.diariomas.hn/2018/08/21/hector-vargas-recibe-su-merecido-por-la-crdn/ |website=DiarioMas.hn |publisher=[[La Tribuna (Honduras)|Diario Mas]] |access-date=21 August 2018}} * On week 5, [[Real C.D. España]] faced [[C.D. Marathón]] in the [[Clásico Sampedrano]]. In the pre-match, the game was already heated. Real España as hosts, announced that only people dressed with the home team colors would be allowed to access the stadium. The game elapsed with normalcy until Real España missed a penalty kick, which provoked the fury of the local crowd. A few fans invaded the pitch but were easily controlled by the police. A few minutes before the end, Marathón's keeper [[Dénovan Torres]] hit one of the sideline [[ball boy]]s. This action triggered an energetic response from the Real España's subs which were warming up nearby. Torres and the entire Marathón's technical staff were expelled from the game. Some Marathón fans, including women, were beaten in the stands by their counterparts. Marathón requested the league the closure of the venue and Real España sued Torres for his actions.
